newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: UBS WINS TENDER TO ADVISE ON TELECOM SALE.
newsitem.headline: UBS WINS TENDER TO ADVISE ON TELECOM SALE.

text.p: Lithuania's ministry for European affairs said on Thursday that Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) had won a tender to act as lead advisor in the sale of Lithuanian Telecom.
"UBS had the highest scores and their technical proposal was the best," Vytenis Junevichius, the director of the ministry's privatisation department, told Reuters.
He added that if a contract is not signed with UBS by August, then the government would enter negotiations with runner-up Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
Seven banks and financial insitutions had placed technical offers for the tender.
The government hopes that the 100 percent state-owned phone company will be delivered into private hands next year.
Lithuanian Telecom is one of 13 key state assets which the right-of-centre government has pledged to sell.
